name: v0.2.0
body:
First minor release since `v0.1.0` (2026-05-12). Captures the work from Sessions 78–110 — most substantively:

## Highlights

- **Business-value capture** — the intake interview now drives toward a `ValueMeasurementPlan`; the data agent collects an executed `BaselineSnapshot`; the website agent renders a business case plus a Production Measurement Plan. Business value is estimated *before* model construction and made measurable *downstream* once the model is in production.
- **Governance-framework reconciliation (Audit #39)** — the intake prompt's regulatory-framework enumeration and the website agent's `_FRAMEWORK_ARTIFACTS` map are reconciled and protected by an import-time drift guard. `GDPR_ART_22` now scaffolds artifacts (previously silently mapped to none); the dead `EU_AI_ACT` alias was removed; `ASOP_56` is mapped.
- **Documentation accuracy** — a full wiki-wide code-citation audit verified all 118 `file.py:N-M` references and corrected 43 drifted current-pointer citations across the reference pages.

Version markers set to `0.2.0` across `pyproject.toml`, the data-agent package, `src/model_project_constructor/__init__.py`, and `README.md`.

See [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/rmsharp/claims-model-starter/blob/v0.2.0/CHANGELOG.md) (`[0.2.0]`) for the full commit-linked maintainer-facing ledger.

name: v0.1.0
body:
First release tag on the **Model Project Constructor** project — `v0.1.0`, created 2026-05-12 on commit `b4c0dbb` (Session 74; the first git tag in the repository). Marks the initial versioned checkpoint of the multi-agent pipeline that takes a P&C-claims business idea from intake interview through data collection and validation to an initial model website.

## Highlights

- **Data source inventory contract (Phases 3–4)** — the optional `DataSourceInventory` plug-in boundary is wired end to end: the data agent consumes a curated inventory, and the orchestrator can derive one from the intake interview via `intake_qa_pairs_to_inventory` (the `--inventory-from-intake` flag), while preserving the data agent's reuse decoupling.
- **Version markers aligned to canonical PEP 440** — `README.md` reconciled to the `0.1.0` literal already carried by `pyproject.toml`, `src/model_project_constructor/__init__.py`, and the data-agent package; first release tag cut.
- **Pipeline documentation** — the wiki (`Schema-Reference`, `Data-Guide`, `Worked-Examples`, `Pipeline-Overview`), `packages/data-agent/USAGE.md`, and the architecture plan document the data-source-inventory types and the intake-derivation flow.

See [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/rmsharp/claims-model-starter/blob/v0.1.0/CHANGELOG.md) (`[0.1.0]`) for the full commit-linked maintainer-facing ledger.
